text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
The true 'Holy Sword'! It is something 
that holds true whenever, wherever, and 
against whoever!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
There is no hesitation. Just the moment we 
pass the 600-meter marker—

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Draw the blade! And strike down without 
hesitation. Haaaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOAAAHH!)

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Alright—just as I envisioned! If I run 
like this!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was sensational. A razor-sharp turn of 
foot that reduced every race to a contest 
of just the final three furlongs.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Durandal has splendidly perfected the 
'Holy Sword.'"

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
My King, thank you for waiting. Thanks to 
your keen insight and guidance—

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
That swing with everything she had, I 
think it sent it soaring high into the 
air.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even so, today is just a test swing. It's 
what comes next that will show her true 
worth.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
The official debut will be――at the next 
stage.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
The grand finale of the spring sprint 
division, the Yasuda Kinen. In that mile 
race—

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
"Let us pay a visit to our old rivals and 
yet-unseen formidable foes."

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
For the Everlasting Kingdom. A strike to 
herald its dawn!
choice_data_list: Yeah, let's give them a surprise!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even so, we still don't know what kind of 
rivals will enter the Yasuda Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Unexpected medium-distance Umamusume might 
also join mile races...

"The Yasuda Kinen... Maybe I could go for 
this around here. Yes..."
Since I can handle both!

In the Classic Triple Crown, I... couldn't 
win for the longest time. But...
I want to stand in the center too!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
"There will likely be wielders of 
unfamiliar and exotic swords that I know 
nothing of. Even so—"

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
I will not back down a single step! I will 
definitely prove it at the Yasuda Kinen— 
the sheer magnificence of a knight's 
sword!
